titre: Changing your child's address after a separation (Caf, school, social security)
resume: Who to notify, and in what order, when your child's address changes: Caf, school, Assurance Maladie, tax office, all at once if possible, with the documents to prepare and your obligations toward the other parent.
aQuoiCaSert: After a separation, a child's address often changes, or the child now lives in two homes. Updating this address prevents lost mail, family benefits that are miscalculated or paid to the wrong parent, and missed information from the school. This guide lists the steps, office by office, and reminds you what the law requires to keep the other parent informed.
quiEstConcerne: The parent the child now lives with, or who is moving with the child.
Parents with shared residence, who must declare both addresses and choose how to split family benefits.
aSavoir: The free online service "Je change de coordonnées" on service-public.gouv.fr sends your new address, in a single step, to more than 30 national bodies (tax office, Assurance Maladie (French public health insurance), France Travail (the public employment service), pension funds, some energy suppliers) and to more than 4,500 connected town halls (mairies). It does not update the electoral rolls: you still need to do that with your town.

Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office): report the separation and the move quickly in your online account. For housing benefit, make a new application as soon as you move into the new home. If you forgot in good faith, the right to make a mistake (droit à l'erreur) applies if you correct it quickly. With the MSA (Mutualité sociale agricole, the farmers' social security fund), use your private MSA account.

Shared residence and the Caf: fill in form cerfa n° 14000. The parents can name a single beneficiary or split the family allowances; if they disagree, each parent automatically receives a share. Other benefits go to one parent only, except the complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG, childcare allowance). The choice can be changed after one year, unless the children's residence changes.
In mainland France, family allowances are only paid from 2 dependent children: with only one child, there is nothing to split on this basis.

Assurance Maladie: change your address in your ameli account, by phone on 3646, or by letter to the CPAM (Caisse primaire d'assurance maladie, the local health insurance fund) with your social security number, your old and new addresses, the date of the move and a copy of your ID.
Tax office: report your address in your personal account on impots.gouv.fr, then state the move and its date in your income tax return.

School: you must tell the school about any change in family situation or address, and about any decision of the family court judge (juge aux affaires familiales, JAF) concerning the child. Unless the judge decides otherwise, the school gives the same information to each parent.

A parent moving: a separated parent has the right to move. If this changes how parental authority is exercised (for example visiting rights), they must inform the other parent in advance, as early as possible. If the child lives with them under a judgment or an agreement, they must give their new address no later than 1 month after moving, or face 6 months' imprisonment and a €7,500 fine.
If you disagree about the move or where the child lives: family mediation, or an application to the family court judge (JAF) where the child lives (a lawyer is not required).

documents.libelle: Proof of your new address (preferably less than 3 months old)
documents.detail: Lease or rent receipt, water or electricity bill. If someone is housing you: a certificate of accommodation, plus that person's ID and proof of address.

documents.libelle: Old address and date of the move
documents.detail: Requested by the Assurance Maladie if you make the request by letter.

documents.libelle: ID of the parent making the declaration (front-and-back copy)
documents.detail: For letters to the CPAM and to create a Caf account.

documents.libelle: Caf beneficiary number, social security number and tax number
documents.detail: Found on your Caf letters, your carte Vitale (health insurance card) and your tax notice. Needed for any online or written request.

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement on the child's residence (copy)
documents.detail: For the school, the Caf and social security if a decision sets the residence or gives parental authority to one parent only.

documents.libelle: Form "Enfant(s) en résidence alternée : déclaration et choix des parents" (cerfa n° 14000)
documents.detail: Shared residence only. Signed by both parents if you agree. Available on service-public.gouv.fr and caf.fr.

documents.libelle: Copy of the letter informing the other parent of the new address
documents.detail: Keep dated proof (registered letter, email or message) that you gave this information.
With both parents' contact details and the people allowed to pick up the child.

etapes.detail: Before the move if the child's arrangements change, and in any case no later than 1 month after if the child lives with you under a judgment or agreement. Keep a written record.
On service-public.gouv.fr, online service "Je change de coordonnées": tick the bodies to notify (tax office, Assurance Maladie, town hall if connected, energy).

etapes.titre: Report the separation and the address to the Caf
etapes.detail: In your Mon Compte account: change of situation, change of address, then a new housing benefit application. With shared residence, send cerfa n° 14000.
ameli account or 3646. Take the opportunity to check which parent the child is attached to.

etapes.titre: Check before going to the school
etapes.detail: Proof of new address, judgment or agreement if there is one, full contact details of both parents, list of people allowed to pick up the child. Ask for letters to be sent to both addresses.
Give the updated information form to the principal or the school office. Remember the canteen, after-school care and school transport too.

etapes.titre: Finish with the bodies not covered
etapes.detail: Bank, home and school insurance, mutuelle (top-up health insurance), doctor, the child's activities, registration on the electoral rolls at the town hall.

ou.detail: Single, free declaration to more than 30 bodies.
Mon Compte area on caf.fr or the Caf - Mon Compte app. MSA for the agricultural scheme.
Personal account, or your local public finance center (centre des finances publiques).

ou.nom: Your child's school (école, collège or lycée)
ou.detail: School principal or the school office.
